inspection.finding: The multimodal loader declines from_pretrained layer streaming whenever block_swap_load_device(device_map) is None, including a multi-GPU balanced map.
block_swap_load_device resolves placement strategies only when one GPU is visible; a split map is not a one-GPU load.
Native unsloth / unsloth_balanced planner can describe multi-GPU streaming, but vision loader guard precedes that resolution.

conclusion: The tested multimodal T4 loader cannot use this streaming path. This is a backend limitation, not proof that every implementation of 27B QLoRA is impossible. Native planner without layer offload can give a precise fit diagnosis before downloading weights.

next_probe.purpose: Obtain a head-aware native-planner memory diagnosis rather than repeat generic balanced placement.
